title: Kissan Help Desk
intro: Kissan Help Desk is a digital platform designed to deliver clear, practical and localized farming guidance to farmers. We simplify modern agricultural practices so every farmer can make better decisions.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: To empower farmers with technology and knowledge so they can increase productivity, reduce risk, and improve income through data-backed, easy-to-follow advice.

services.title: Crop Advisory
services.desc: Seasonal and location-based crop recommendations (variety, sowing time, spacing).

services.title: Fertilizer & Pesticide Guidance
services.desc: Correct dosage, timing and safety steps to protect crops and farmers.

services.title: Weather Alerts
services.desc: Local short-term weather updates and actionable alerts to help plan field operations.

services.title: Marketplace
services.desc: Price signals and demand information to help sell produce better.

services.title: Farmer Profile
services.desc: Track fields, inputs and past recommendations to receive personalised advice.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: Make modern, science-based farming accessible to every farmer — reduce losses and increase sustainable profits.
